title: Rethinking the Role of Proxy Rewards in Language Model Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating proxy reward functions with a specific Length Incentive (LI) during RLHF to determine if solely generating longer responses artificially inflates gold reward scores and human preference approximations.

Designing white-box reward functions incorporating interpretable features like repetition penalties and query relevance to reverse-engineer and analyze how superficial text properties drive proxy reward signals.
